summary:
Wrote plan.md (all coordinates, no build or render yet). Natural History: a grey-white granite ring of ranges with a 6-column portico, a pediment at y 22 and a low green copper dome at y 26 on a drum centred at x 57, plus hipped red roofs. American History: a long, low pink marble box (6:1, like the real one) with panels and window slots, a deep unbroken cornice band and a glowing clerestory and atrium. African American History: a bronze corona of three tiers stepping out 1 block per tier, copper-grate lattice glowing amber over a recessed glass base, a porch canopy and reflecting pools. Three exterior-only landmarks on the Mall: grey-white Beaux-Arts NMNH (portico, pediment, green ribbed dome, red hipped wings), pink-beige NMAH box with deep cornice band and glass recess, and the bronze lattice three-tier NMAAHC Corona.
elements.md lists each element's construction; plan.md now has PALETTE, VOCABULARY, ROOMS and PARTS below the architect's form.
Dusk light is hidden froglights and lanterns throughout, with floodlights at the NMNH portico bases.

NMNH shell: The NMNH shell is built in parts/nmnh-shell.mjs, and make.sh produces a whole build.nbt with no refused writes. It has the ranges, central range, end pavilions with attics, south pavilion, portico platform, north porch, 1960s wings and annex, and the octagon drum (`octagonDrum`). The south bays use `ashlarBay`. Walls are solid with plinth, rustic and string courses. Windows and doors are left as air, and the courts are paved.
polish: The portico entablature (y11, z40..42) and the cornice (y16, z40..42) are not built: P4 or the roofs part must add them. The pavilion pediment rests on that cornice.
The 1960s wing coping at y11 is left to the roofs part. The decks at y10 and y6 are laid.
The gaps beside the drum at x47..52 and x62..67, z33..36, above y11 are open. The pavilion gable and the range roofs must close them.
The drum has 4 orphan calcite blocks at its diagonals (50,18,21 and similar), from the helper.
The roof.json in the kit is stale: it gives off-palette blocks (mud_brick, mangrove) and 85 shell cells above the eave cleared.
The south bay window slots are at x35, 39, 43 and 71, 75, 79, not x25..29 as in OPENINGS, because pilasters sit on x25, 29, 33…. Windows left over on the pavilion fronts are 2-wide.
Planting beds and court lamps are left to P6.
The south-range wall at x32, 45..46, 68 and 81..82 is plain, with no window.
NMNH shell: still OFF-PALETTE: brick_slab x456 (roof.json), bricks x89 (roof.json)

summary:
NMAH shell and facade: NMAH shell and facade built in parts/nmah.mjs: plinth y0, hollow white-terracotta box (walls y1..8, deck y9) with panel-and-slot faces on all four sides, south recess under the 3-deep overhang via glassFront, cornice band, atrium opening with froglights, clerestory penthouse with skylight, north loading strip, south and west terraces.
make.sh ran clean: NMAH placed 16411 cells, 0 refused, 0 off-palette. mcd check shows no NMAH orphans or floating blocks; the 6 remaining orphans are NMNH's.
Plan ticks: P2 in plan.md, and elements.md items for the box, cornice, penthouse, glass front and atrium.
polish: Doors are air for P5: south glass doors x150..154 y1..2 behind the recess, north doors z2 x150..154 y1..2, west door x122 z15..17 y1..2.
Terrace lanterns every 8 on the south and west terraces are not placed (P6 grounds), so the NMAH terrace is unlit by this part.
Pane connection states are not set (gray_stained_glass_pane placed bare); the glassFront helper sets its own mullions.
The box is 61x25 on the map's footprint, not the 6:1 in the text. I followed the map, as plan.md says.
NMNH shell's roof (roof.json) places off-palette brick_slab x456 and bricks x89: not this part, but it will fail the palette report at merge.
NMNH shell leaves 6 orphans (calcite and polished_granite_slab at the portico and pediment): not this part's.

waste.tool: panelSlotWall opts: an explicit centre column and a skip list (x ranges that stay air), so a face split by an entrance keeps the plan rhythm

waste.what: Found the froglight orphans only after a build and mcd check; the pad sat two cells in air, in front of the pane, with nothing under it.
waste.cost: one make.sh rebuild and a check round

companions.task: Fit the south recess glass (glassFront panes, mullions, the doors at x150..154 y1..2), the north and west doors, the atrium skylight glass and the penthouse clerestory ribbon.
Lay the plinth edge, the south and west terrace slabs and the north loading wall, and check the joints where the panel-and-slot walls meet the plinth and cornice band.
Light the south and west terraces with lanterns every 8 and the recessed entrance soffit, and check the atrium floor-edge froglights read through the skylight at dusk.

summary: Roofs, dome and Corona: ["parts/roofs-corona.mjs builds the NMNH dome, lantern cap, south pavilion red-tile gable and pediment, plus the NMAAHC plinth, lobby glass base with ceiling, three Corona tiers with shadow bands and coping, and the porch canopy.", "make.sh produces a whole build.nbt with no REFUSED writes in this part; `check` reports 0 floating blocks, and `fit` lists 17 dome stairs on bottom slabs.", "Off-palette: the red-tile roof tool emits brick_slab, granite_slab, mud_brick_*, mangrove_* and bricks, which palette.json does not list; roof.json (NMNH ranges) is unchanged and still reports them under the shell line."]
polish: Palette gap: palette.json's nmnh-roof role lacks the slab and stair variants the red-tile roof tool derives (brick_slab, granite_slab, mud_brick_stairs/slab, mangrove_slab/stairs, bricks, granite, polished_granite_stairs). Fix in palette.json or accept the report; roof.json and the pavilion gable in my module both hit it. Not edited, since palette.json is shared.
NMNH ranges' roof.json is laid by runParts, not by my part; its ridge slabs stick out at z10 (x55, x59, y16) and the hip ridge is not the plan's ROOFS 'hipped' detail. Not edited.

Dome: `fit` reports 17 oxidized_cut_copper_stairs standing on bottom slabs at y22 (domeRibbed's foot courses, e.g. 49,22,25 and 50,22,23). Cosmetic; needs a top-slab or full-block course in domeRibbed or a local fix.

South pavilion gable ridge tops out at y21 (plan says 22). The gable's eave corners (47,16,36 and 67,16,36) are orphans; the pediment rows y17..22 sit on it now, so 0 floating, but the cornice y16 (P4) is still expected.

Porch canopy built (x192..210 z22..31 y8, posts z31). Reflecting pools are P6 and not built here. elements.md lines for the wings' red-tile roofs and the porch canopy are left unticked: the roof is off-palette and the canopy's pools are P6.
Drum orphans (calcite at 50,18,21 / 64,18,21 / 50,18,33 / 64,18,33) are P1's octagonDrum cells, not mine; left for the shell owner.

waste.what: Hand-tested five roof.json material mixes (brick/granite stairs, polished granite slab, steep vs half pitch, eave variants) to find a palette-only red-tile roof, one dry-run each.
waste.tool: A roof material option that restricts derived slab and stair variants to the palette's ids (or the palette declaring its stair/slab pairs), so `mcd roof --spec ... --dry-run` reports OFF-PALETTE up front.

waste.what: Worked out Corona tier coordinates (half-sizes 9, 10, 11, 12, 13 for the shadow bands and tier rings) by hand to match coronaTier's inset convention.
waste.cost: about 6 coordinate checks in my head, one re-run to confirm
waste.tool: coronaTier could take the plan's band and lattice rows as a list, or a corona() helper could place all three tiers plus their shadow bands from plan.md's table.

waste.what: Wrote a ringAir helper (perimeter of a square at a course, air-only) for the Corona shadow bands and coping, because no vocab helper places a single ring.
waste.tool: A ring(g, [cx, cz], half, y, block, state) helper in vocab/h2 that the corona, the shadow bands and the coping can share.

waste.what: Found that the glass base's ceiling pads sat in open air, so check flagged 6 floating froglights; fixed by adding a lobby ceiling by hand.
waste.tool: glassBase could place its own ceiling (inset 1 at y1+1) so the pads always sit on something.

companions.task: Lay the red-tile hip roofs and the south pavilion gable with a palette-only material mix, so the roof stays inside palette.json without derived slabs.
Shape the dome's foot courses so each stair course sits on a full block or top slab (fixes the 17 fit issues) and check the ribs' seam lines.
Set the pediment's raking cornice and the cornice band at y16 (P4) so the pediment has a real bearing course, and confirm the portico's attic height against the gable.
Set the Corona's brown glass and froglight rows (P3 rows y10, 14, 18) so the amber glow reads evenly from the aerial view.

summary:
NMNH facade order: NMNH facade order is built in parts/nmnh-facade.mjs: six portico columns with a z42 entablature and cornice, eight south-range pilasters, balustrade dies, eight pavilion engaged columns, the thermal window, six tall-window recesses, and the drum via octagonDrum.
Shafts are full quartz_pillar courses with chiseled capitals, not the quartz_slab-base helpers, because fit flags a shaft on a bottom slab. make.sh saves a whole build.nbt with 0 refused and 0 off-palette in this part; fit reports OK and the portico zoom reads correctly.
Plan.md checklist ticked P4 and the matching elements.md items are ticked, with P4 notes added.
polish: Not built: pavilion end windows (x24..25, 28..29 at z42, y5..9); ground-storey windows at y2..3 under each tall window (tallWindow needs height 3 or more); the string course at y4 and the plinth at y1 (the shell owns the skin; they need it to leave the front as air); the drum's cornice ring and pilasters are called through octagonDrum and are refused where the shell already holds the drum, so confirm the drum comes from one owner.

Plan conflicts resolved in my copy, for the orchestrator: thermal glass sits at z41 because the shell fills the attic at z40 (the plan says z40); tall windows sit at x 35, 39, 43, 71, 75, 79 (the plan's OPENINGS list says x 25, 29, 33…, which contradicts its FACADES rule); the entablature is only z42 because the shell holds y11 at z40..41.
Column shafts have no quartz_slab base (fit flags a shaft on a bottom slab); the vocab's corinthianColumn and pilaster helpers still have that issue.
Fit reports OK for the build. Check still reports 6 orphans, all outside P4: four calcite at y18 on the drum's z21 and z33 faces (shell or drum) and two polished_granite_slab at y16 z10 (roof, P3).

waste.what: Worked out the bay lines, pavilion exclusions and window centres by hand (57±4n, skipping the portico and pavilions), and found plan.md's OPENINGS list (x 25, 29, 33…) contradicts its FACADES rhythm (57±4n±2).
waste.cost: about 10 minutes of reasoning and two plan-internal contradictions to resolve by judgement
waste.tool: A plan-coordinate helper that takes an axis, a bay rhythm and an exclusion list and returns the pilaster and window centres, plus a lint that checks the OPENINGS table against the FACADES rule.

waste.what: Discovered by fit that vocab's corinthianColumn and pilaster put a quartz_slab base under the shaft, which fit flags as a shaft on a bottom slab, and rewrote 22 columns locally.
waste.cost: one failed build and fit pass plus a local column() helper
waste.tool: Fix corinthianColumn/pilaster in vocab (full-course base or top slab) so the vocab passes fit by default.

waste.what: Found the shell already holds y11 at z40..41 and the attic at z40, so the entablature and thermal glass had to move to z42 and z41; the first build refused 42 writes.
waste.cost: one refused build (42 writes) and a re-plan of the z coordinates
waste.tool: A runParts pre-check or the plan's ownership map that lists which cells each part is allowed to write, so the conflict shows before the build.

waste.what: Checked the portico by eye with zoom renders instead of a per-element check.
waste.tool: A tile-and-label check that reports, for each plan element, whether its cells are present in the build.

companions.task: Build the portico platform's column bases and the chiseled capitals, so the column base moulding (quartz_slab) can return without the fit failure.
Cut the upside-down quartz_stairs cornice and the raking sills so they sit flush on the entablature and the pilaster capitals.
Take the pediment's raking cornice and the drum's cornice ring at y19 so the roof closes onto the drum and portico without gaps.

summary:
Glazing, doors, lighting: Glazing, doors and lighting part is in parts/glaze-light.mjs: 465 panes and doors placed into the air openings the shells left (NMNH south bays, pavilions, north range and door, drum slits; NMAH entrance and doors; NMAAHC doors), 0 refused, no off-palette blocks; make.sh gives a whole build.nbt.
The south tall windows sit on the shell's bays at x35/39/43/71/75/79, not the plan's x25..89 spacing. Thermal window glass is on rows y12, 14 and 15 only, since the roof's brick slab fills y13.
Lighting and the portico floods are not done: no froglights at the portico, no NMAH atrium light on a floor yet, and `mcd check` flags the NMAH glass and froglights as floating until part 2 lays the plinth and floor.
polish: 1960s wings: the shell left no window slots (x0..21 and x93..114 are solid calcite at y5..9), so no wing windows are glazed; the shell needs slots every 3 cells.
NMNH portico floods (floodBase at z41 y4 beside each column base) not placed: the platform and the z40..41 portico void are solid at y4..5 in the shell.

Thermal window: the roof's brick_slab fills y13 at z40 (roof.json offPalette brick_slab/bricks), so the window's bottom row is missing and the rows at y14 float over the slabs (fit: 'glass_pane on a bottom slab').
NMAH atrium froglights (y1), west doors (x122) and north doors float until part 2 lays the y0 plinth and floor; check again after the merge.
Drum diagonal slots: none found in the shell (the diagonal walls are sparse), so only the four flat slits are glazed.
Main NMNH door is glass panes (3x4), not glass double doors; the side doors are iron_door pairs at y5..6 with a glass transom at y7; NMAAHC main doors are glass 5x2.
No lanterns, lamp posts or light check were run (`mcd light` not executed). Lanterns on dies come from the balustrade helper in part 4; the lantern cap is part 3.

waste.what: Finding which openings the shells left as air: I dumped rows of blocks cell by cell with throwaway scripts to locate the south bays, pavilion windows, north bays and drum slits.
waste.cost: about 3 scan passes over ~400 cells, plus reading the shell notes by eye
waste.tool: a `mcd openings build.nbt --face south --y 2..9` command listing air runs per wall row and face, so the glazier starts from the holes the shell actually left

waste.what: Pane connection states: I wrote my own glazeCells to set east/west or north/south on every glass_pane from its neighbours, because the vocab helpers only settle panes inside tallWindow/glassFront.
waste.cost: one helper, about 40 lines, plus a retry after the door helper signature was wrong
waste.tool: a build-library `glazeRect(g, box, plane)` (or `glazing` on a plain rectangle) that places panes and sets connections; also an exported `settlePanes` in vocab/h3.mjs

waste.what: Checking the drum slits, thermal window and door cells one by one, and reading `mcd zoom` after each change.
waste.cost: about 6 query passes and 2 zoom renders
waste.tool: `mcd render --tiles` at a useful size (the whole-site front elevation was only 300 px wide, unreadable); `mcd zoom` with `--at` for a face is the one that worked

companions.task: Glaze the NMNH wing slots and the thermal window's bottom row once the roof and shell leave air there, with the pane connections settled per run.
Place the portico floodlights (two ochre_froglight at each column base, z41 y4) and the lamps on the dies, once the shell leaves air in front of the column line; measure dark cells with mcd light.
Replace the roof's brick_slab at y13 z40 over the thermal window with a clear attic, so the window's bottom row is not sealed by the roof.
